--CREATE VIEW CALENDAR

CREATE VIEW gold.calendar
AS
SELECT
*
FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'abfss://silver@datalakeazureproject.dfs.core.windows.net/AdventureWorks_Calendar/',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
)as QUERYY1;
